{"body_text":"Event Icon Management System v1.0
Overview:
The purpose of this system is to create a structure for the LiveOps event icons. This system dictates the following:
The number of icons on a scene
When they will appear whether locked or unlocked
What side of the screen will an icon appear
In what order an icon will appear
When will the icon disappear and/or change places
The various elements on the icon like time, buttons, notifications, etc.
Seasonal changes
What’s in it for [SOURCE_ORG_0451]:
To have an across-prototype transferable Live Operations icon ordering.
Main Workings:
Icon Amount
The main UI can have a maximum of 10 icons on the screen at any given time.
If the situation calls for more icons, both of the columns will shrink in icon size and the slot amount will be increased accordingly.

{"id":"harmonygames-Games/match3d#402#rc_1","pr_id":"harmonygames-Games/match3d#402","author_login":"PERSON_6026_GITHUB_USERNAME","body":"_⚠️ Potential issue_

**Bug: Returning to 1x speed does not restore targetFrameRate and fixedDeltaTime.**

Currently, when speed ≈ 1, you set Time.timeScale back to 1 and flip _fastModeActive=false, but you do not restore Application.targetFrameRate or Time.fixedDeltaTime. This leaves the editor in a throttled/altered state, and ReturnFromPlay won’t restore either because _fastModeActive is already false.

Fix by:
- Restoring frame rate and physics step when speed returns to 1.
- Capturing baselines only when entering fast mode (to avoid compounding baselines on repeated slider changes).

This keeps the physics scaling in line with team practice (fixedDeltaTime divided by timeScale per prior learning) while ensuring clean restoration.
